development.state: source-published; integrated IEC metadata and epoch-aware mixed NTSC/PAL archive software validation; Driver192 physical acquisition and complete signed app UI unqualified

qualification.public_summary: Alpha0.0.94 integrates 256 IEC pack classifications/274 layout variants and epoch-aware mixed NTSC/PAL archives, maps and byte-exact segmented exports. Accepted source software tests:527 Swift tests plus14 XCTest cases; native mixed playback and archive/metadata components measured offline. Complete signed app UI and exact Driver192 acquisition remain unqualified. Earlier bounded B190 capture evidence is historical and applies only to its tested development setup.
qualification.architecture: Apple silicon (app arm64, driver arm64e); Intel unsupported
qualification.hardware_scope: Historical bounded B190 evidence only: one Sony HVR-M15U recorded NTSC DV setup; current Driver192 hardware matrix not run
qualification.dv_playback: Mixed NTSC/PAL epoch-aware playback/archive paths validated offline; rendered archive/metadata components exercised; full signed app workspace displayed-pixel association remains unqualified
qualification.full_tape_endurance: not qualified for Driver192 or this exact public package
qualification.distribution: App, driver and CLI are ad-hoc signed with hardened runtime and are not notarized. Driver installation requires SIP disabled; offline playback, Surgery and inspection require no driver activation. Fresh-system installation and exact public-package hardware qualification remain unverified.
qualification.capture: No physical acquisition qualification for Driver192. Historical B190 bounded NTSC evidence is separate and does not qualify this package.
qualification.hot_unload: unqualified; use shutdown/restart-based replacement or removal; successful live extension disable is not a prerequisite for normal capture STOP
qualification.startup: stable final generation before capture; no reset observed during these bounded captures; broader startup/reset coverage remains open
qualification.automation: 66 same-user CLI/MCP tools; session-scoped sandbox grants; driver activation and physical recovery require interactive GUI; no new hardware automation qualification
qualification.iec_metadata: 256 allocations and274 layouts inventoried; software classification and raw preservation tested; complete IEC certification not claimed; VAUX0x61 interpretation unresolved
qualification.mixed_archive: Source-bound recording epochs and ordered lossless segmented exports validated offline; unknown regions preserved; mixed-system single-file merge and film/container output reject explicitly; HDV remains separate
